tools.name: fieldedge_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders (jobs) of the company with status, service address, customer, primary technician and linked invoice. Filters combine with AND; assigned=false cannot be combined with primary_tech_id. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_work_order
tools.description: One work order: status, assignments, service address, task, tags and linked invoice. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_search_work_orders_by_address
tools.description: Work orders at a service address, most recent first, each with its customer's name. All of address_line_1, city, state and postal_code are required. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/search/by-address.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_work_order_assignments
tools.description: Technician assignments (schedule, status) on one work order. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments.

tools.name: fieldedge_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers (personal data). With no filter all customers are listed. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customers/search.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_customer
tools.description: One customer (or job location) by id, with contact details and address (personal data). The reply says whether the record is a job or a billing customer. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customers/id/{customer_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_customer_by_phone
tools.description: The customer with this phone number (personal data). Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customer/{phone}.

tools.name: fieldedge_search_customers_by_address
tools.description: Customers at a street address (personal data). address_line_1, city, state and postal_code are required. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customers/by-address.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_customer_notes
tools.description: Notes on a customer record, newest first by default. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/notes.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_customer_attachments
tools.description: File attachments on a customer record, each with the blob URL to view or download it. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/attachments.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_tags
tools.description: Reusable customer tags of the account. Needs scope customers:read. GET /open-api/v1/tags.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices by invoice date, without line items (use fieldedge_get_invoice for those). Needs scope invoices:read. GET /open-api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice with its line items; the invoice id equals its work order id. Needs scope invoices:read. GET /open-api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_quotes
tools.description: Quotes, without line items (use fieldedge_get_quote for those). Prefer class_id over class_name. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/quotes.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_quote
tools.description: One quote with its line items; the quote id equals its work order id. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/quotes/{quote_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_agreements
tools.description: Service agreements (recurring maintenance contracts) with plan, dates and customer. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/agreements.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_agreement
tools.description: One service agreement by id. Needs scope workorders:read. GET /open-api/v1/agreements/{agreement_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_employees
tools.description: Employees (technicians, dispatchers, CSRs, admins). Needs scope employees:read. GET /open-api/v1/employees.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_employee
tools.description: One employee record. Needs scope employees:read. GET /open-api/v1/employees/{employee_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_business_units
tools.description: Business units (needed to create a work order). Needs scope business-units:read. GET /open-api/v1/business-units.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_business_unit
tools.description: One business unit by id. Needs scope business-units:read. GET /open-api/v1/business-units/{business_unit_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_lead_sources
tools.description: Lead sources (needed to create a work order). Needs scope lead-sources:read. GET /open-api/v1/lead-sources.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_lead_source
tools.description: One lead source by id. Needs scope lead-sources:read. GET /open-api/v1/lead-sources/{lead_source_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (service types, needed to create a work order). Needs scope tasks:read. GET /open-api/v1/tasks.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_task_bundle
tools.description: One task together with its resolved department and skill. Needs scope tasks:read. GET /open-api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/bundle.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_items
tools.description: Inventory items (parts, services) with cost and rate. Needs scope items:read. GET /open-api/v1/items.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_item
tools.description: One inventory item by id. Needs scope items:read. GET /open-api/v1/items/{item_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_item_categories
tools.description: Inventory item categories (tree: childTreeLevel, parent). Needs scope item-categories:read. GET /open-api/v1/item-categories.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_item_category
tools.description: One item category by id. Needs scope item-categories:read. GET /open-api/v1/item-categories/{item_category_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_sales_tax_codes
tools.description: Sales tax codes. Needs scope items:read. GET /open-api/v1/sales-tax-codes.

tools.name: fieldedge_list_warehouses
tools.description: Inventory warehouses. Needs scope warehouses:read. GET /open-api/v1/warehouses.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_warehouse
tools.description: One warehouse by id. Needs scope warehouses:read. GET /open-api/v1/warehouses/{warehouse_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_lead
tools.description: One lead by id (lead-provider integrations). Needs scope leads:read. GET /open-api/v1/leads/{lead_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_get_company
tools.description: The company name for a company id (the tenant id). Needs scope company:read. GET /open-api/v1/companies/{company_id}.

tools.name: fieldedge_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record in FieldEdge, visible to the office staff at once. Needs an e-mail or a phone number (international format, e.g. +14155552671); marketing_email_opt_in needs an e-mail and marketing_sms_opt_in a phone number. Names are 2-50 characters without digits. Check fieldedge_se

tools.name: fieldedge_create_customer_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a free-text note to a customer record; office staff see it in FieldEdge at once. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/notes.

tools.name: fieldedge_update_customer_note
tools.description: WRITE: replace the text of an existing customer note (the old text is lost). Get the note id from fieldedge_list_customer_notes. Needs scope customers:write. PATCH /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/notes/{noteId}.

tools.name: fieldedge_create_tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a reusable customer tag (e.g. "VIP Customer"). Check fieldedge_list_tags first. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/tags.

tools.name: fieldedge_add_customer_tag
tools.description: WRITE: attach an existing tag to a customer; it shows on the customer record in FieldEdge. Needs scope customers:write. POST /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/tags.

tools.name: fieldedge_remove_customer_tag
tools.description: WRITE: detach a tag from a customer (the tag itself stays). Needs scope customers:write. DELETE /open-api/v1/customers/{customerId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: fieldedge_create_work_order
tools.description: WRITE: create a work order for a customer location. business_unit_id, lead_source_id and task_id are required: get them from fieldedge_list_business_units, fieldedge_list_lead_sources and fieldedge_list_tasks. Scheduling, invoice lines and equipment are separate steps (fieldedge_assign_technician fo

tools.name: fieldedge_update_work_order
tools.description: WRITE: partially update a work order; only the fields you pass change. Can reassign the primary technician, change description/notes, and mark it completed (with a resolution) or cancel it (cancel_note). Look at fieldedge_get_work_order first. Needs scope workorders:write. PATCH /open-api/v1/work-or

tools.name: fieldedge_assign_technician
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a technician on a work order. The assignment appears on the Dispatch Board at once and FieldEdge returns no assignment id: list the assignments afterwards to find it. Needs scope workorders:write. POST /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments.

tools.name: fieldedge_update_assignment_status
tools.description: WRITE: move an assignment to pending, traveling, working, paused, completed or canceled. It triggers the same customer notifications and dispatch-board updates as a change on the dispatch board and is timestamped now. Canceling needs cancel_note; it fails once the assignment is completed, canceled o

tools.name: fieldedge_remove_assignment
tools.description: WRITE: unassign one technician (by assignment id) from a work order; other technicians on it stay. Get the assignment id from fieldedge_list_work_order_assignments. Needs scope workorders:write. DELETE /open-api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/assignments/{assignmentId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fieldedge_list_customer_attachments, fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_create_tag, fieldedge_add_customer_tag, fieldedge_create_work_order, fieldedge_assign_technician, fieldedge_update_assignment_status · Private data: fieldedge_get_customer, fieldedge_list_customer_notes, fieldedge_list_customer_attachments, fieldedge_get_employee, fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_add_customer_tag · Public sink: fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_create_tag, fieldedge_add_customer_tag, fieldedge_create_work_order, fieldedge_assign_technician · Destructive: fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_remove_customer_tag, fieldedge_remove_assignment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fieldedge_list_customer_attachments, fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_create_tag, fieldedge_add_customer_tag, fieldedge_create_work_order, fieldedge_assign_technician, fieldedge_update_assignment_status · Private data: fieldedge_get_customer, fieldedge_list_customer_notes, fieldedge_list_customer_attachments, fieldedge_get_employee, fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_add_customer_tag · Public sink: fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_create_customer_note, fieldedge_create_tag, fieldedge_add_customer_tag, fieldedge_create_work_order, fieldedge_assign_technician · Destructive: fieldedge_create_customer, fieldedge_remove_customer_tag, fieldedge_remove_assignment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
